properties.name: unresolved_setup widens to either side, after the first cut was caught punishing the brainstorm skill
properties.rationale:
🛑 FOUND BY WALKING INTO IT, TWENTY MINUTES AFTER THE FIRST CUT SHIPPED — and by the agent, on itself, not by a user this time. Recording a brainstorm exactly as the `brainstorm` skill instructs (step 4: relate the new idea to what is already there) drew ANTICIPATES edges from an ACCEPTED Decision and from a TemporalFact to parked ideas. The sweep reported both, and the defect count went 78 -> 80 for following the instructions. That is the same complaint hxm_program filed, surviving the fix meant to answer it.

WHY EITHER SIDE IS RIGHT HERE WHILE `contradiction` NEEDS BOTH, and the asymmetry falls out of what each finding CLAIMS rather than from taste. `unresolved_setup` says "X anticipates Y but nothing follows through" — the complaint is that Y IS UNRESOLVED. When Y is a parked idea, Y being unresolved is exactly what `proposed` MEANS: the recorded idea IS the follow-through, and demanding more is demanding that a brainstorm be finished. When X is parked, a musing anticipating something real has committed to no setup at all. A contradiction, by contrast, is real as soon as ONE side asserts something, which is why it stops at both (`a_proposed_decision_is_not_treated_as_withdrawn`).

⚠️ AND A RULE KEYED ON BOTH ENDPOINTS COULD NEVER HAVE REACHED THE SECOND CASE AT ALL. A TemporalFact is not a Decision and can never be parked, so no tightening of the both-sides rule would have helped; the shape had to change. Worth keeping because it is the general lesson: a predicate scoped to one node type cannot express a rule about edges whose other end is any type.

📌 THE COST SIDE, STATED RATHER THAN BURIED: 28 findings across the two cuts now disappear with nothing anywhere saying they were suppressed or why. `art:heal` realizes `cap:a-sweep-says-what-it-could-not-have-found`, and the existing `parks` mechanism COUNTS parked nodes in `swept.parked` rather than silencing them. This change does not count. Whether to add a `swept.parked_ideas` figure is put to Anthony and NOT decided here.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: `unresolved_setup` now skips when EITHER endpoint is a parked idea, where the first cut required BOTH. `contradiction` is unchanged and still requires both — the asymmetry is deliberate and each rule states its own reasoning. Two new pins in tests/proposed_asserts_nothing.rs cover the cases the first cut missed: an ACCEPTED Decision anticipating a parked idea, and a TemporalFact anticipating one. Core suite 1502 passed / 0 failed across 130 binaries; fmt and clippy clean. Measured on reflow2's own design: 80 -> 61 structural defects, so this widening removed 19 findings where the first cut removed 11 (89 -> 78 -> 61 overall, a 31% reduction).
